text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing school bus loading zone on the north side of Coules Court be replaced with a maximum 10 minutes parking regulation. The proposed parking amendments will provide short-term parking to facilitate pick-up and drop-off of school children at St. Ambrose Catholic School.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing school bus loading zone in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., on the north side of Coules Court (north leg), between a point 72 metres west of Brown's Line and a point 76 metres further west. 2. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 10 minutes from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Coules Court (north leg), between a point 72 metres west of Brown's Line and a point 76 metres further west.
